description: This source file defines the HttpService class which provides HTTP methods (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE) for communication with an API, handling serialization, deserialization, and toast notifications for errors.

classes.name: HttpService
classes.description: A service class for performing HTTP operations with API endpoints, including GET, POST, PUT, and DELETE, with integrated error handling and toast notifications.

methods.name: HttpGet
methods.description: Performs an HTTP GET request to the specified URI, returning deserialized object of type T or null on failure.

methods.name: HttpDelete
methods.description: Performs an HTTP DELETE request to delete an entity by ID at the specified URI, returning deserialized object of type T or null on failure.

methods.name: HttpPost
methods.description: Performs an HTTP POST request with data to the specified URI, returning deserialized object of type T or null on failure; shows toast on error.

methods.name: HttpPut
methods.description: Performs an HTTP PUT request with data to the specified URI, returning deserialized object of type T or null on failure; shows toast on error.

methods.name: ToJson
methods.description: Serializes an object to JSON StringContent for HTTP request body.

methods.name: FromHttpResponseMessage
methods.description: Deserializes JSON content from HttpResponseMessage into an object of type T.
